title: Seat Chop - Broll
description: There are many different parts that make up an aircraft.  Airman First Class Laura Yahemiak introduces us to a group of Marines at Kandahar Air Field, Afghanistan that not only specialize in one important part of an aircraft, but are handy at fixing other parts as well.  Soundbites include LCpl. Christopher Brown - Ejection Seat mechanic; LCpl. Matthew Ducharme - Ejection Seat mechanic and GYSgt. Donald Miner - Ejection Seat mechanic.  Produced by A1C. Laura Yahemjak.  Also available in High Definition.
keywords: Ejection Seat, Christopher Brown, Laura Yahemiak, Matthew Ducharme, Donald Miner, Afghanistan, Marines, aircraft, High Definition, jet, mechanic, Kandahar Air Field
